headline: Apple releases iOS 27.2 with new Siri AI features and Duo Pencil support
summary: Apple has released iOS 27.2 for all its platforms, adding Apple Pencil support and an "Edge Light" video-call feature for the iPhone Duo, new Siri AI tools, dual camera support for FaceTime, and the ability to limit which apps Siri can access.

claims.statement: iOS 27.2 brings Apple Pencil support to the iPhone Duo.

sources.quote: bringing Apple Pencil support to the iPhone Duo

claims.statement: The update also adds an "Edge Light" feature for video calls on the iPhone Duo.

sources.quote: an "Edge Light" feature for the iPhone Duo that's intended to illuminate your face during video calls

claims.statement: Apple rolled out software updates for all its platforms.

sources.quote: Apple has rolled out software updates for all its platforms today.

claims.statement: The update adds more Siri AI tools.

sources.quote: Apple adds more Siri AI tools in its 27.2 system updates

claims.statement: iOS and macOS 27.2 add new Siri AI features and a new Music logo.

sources.quote: Apple releases iOS and macOS 27.2 with new Siri AI features, new Music logo

claims.statement: The update lets users limit which applications Siri can directly access.

sources.quote: Included is the ability to limit which applications Siri can directly access.

claims.statement: iOS 27.2 is the first major update for the current OS, adding dual camera support for FaceTime.

sources.quote: iOS 27.2 is the first major update for the current OS
